presentation.disclaimer: ReadyGate is an independent product concept created by Jeff Schorr to explore adaptive passenger experiences. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by any airline.
presentation.intro: Should a travel app change as your trip moves along? This prototype follows one Virgin Australia flight, VA 313 from Brisbane to Melbourne.

highlights.stageContent: Screen content changes by trip stage

nextjs.title: Next.js App Router
nextjs.detail: File-based routing. Presentation and app routes stay separate.

typescript.title: TypeScript + stage config
typescript.detail: One config layer drives copy and what appears on each screen.

muiTailwind.title: MUI + Tailwind v4
muiTailwind.detail: Accessible components with shared spacing, colour, and type tokens.

framerMotion.title: Framer Motion
framerMotion.detail: Short page and stage transitions. Respects reduced motion.

componentDriven.title: Component-driven UI
componentDriven.detail: Shared cards, health indicators, and countdowns across pages.

mockData.title: Mock data layer
mockData.detail: Fixed simulated journey for demos. No live ops feeds.

brand.idea: Tell passengers what's happening, what to do next, and why it matters.

todayHeader.title: Aujourd'hui s'adapte à l'étape
todayHeader.body: Le titre, le statut et le message rassurant évoluent avec le voyage — toujours centré sur l'essentiel maintenant.

nextAction.title: Une prochaine action claire
nextAction.body: Au lieu de tout afficher d'un coup, ReadyGate met en avant une seule priorité pour ce moment du voyage.

mainNav.title: Vol, voyage et destination
mainNav.body: Chaque zone couvre une facette du voyage — l'essentiel aujourd'hui, le parcours complet, le vol et l'arrivée.

utilityActions.title: Notifications et paramètres
utilityActions.body: La cloche signale les alertes voyage. Les paramètres permettent de changer la langue, les unités et l'accessibilité.

hero.title: Know what matters at each stage of your trip.
hero.descriptionBefore: ReadyGate is an interactive concept designed around
hero.descriptionAfter: . It adapts from planning through arrival, highlights what you need now, and keeps updates clear and timely.
hero.descriptionSecondary: Follow one day of travel from Brisbane to Melbourne and see how home, flight, destination, and updates change as the journey progresses.
hero.credit: Passenger travel app concept by Jeff Schorr.
hero.mobileQrHint: Scan this QR code on your phone to open the demo on mobile.
hero.mobileQrAlt: QR code linking to the ReadyGate mobile demo

glance.title: ReadyGate at a glance
glance.intro: ReadyGate changes as your trip progresses. Follow one demo flight from Brisbane to Melbourne and see how the app shifts its focus from planning through boarding to arrival, always showing what matters now.

adaptive.title: Adaptive
adaptive.copy: The home screen, flight view, and destination details change with each journey stage. Not one static dashboard for the whole trip.

personalised.title: Personalised
personalised.copy: Language, time format, units, and accessibility settings apply live across the demo.

focused.title: Focused
focused.copy: Each screen highlights one clear next action, such as leave time, gate, or boarding, instead of every detail at once.

foundations.title: How it is built
foundations.intro: ReadyGate combines structured front-end architecture with reusable components, accessibility, and internationalisation to support calm, readable passenger experiences.

nextjs.title: Next.js
nextjs.copy: App Router, production routing and a clear application structure.

react.title: React
react.copy: Reusable components with a clear separation of concerns.

typescript.title: TypeScript
typescript.copy: Strong typing for maintainability and confidence.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.copy: Keyboard navigation, reduced motion, semantic HTML and ARIA support.

i18n.title: Internationalisation
i18n.copy: Complete English and Japanese interfaces with a scalable localisation structure.

preferences.title: Traveller Preferences
preferences.copy: Live personalisation for language, time, units and accessibility settings.

journeyEngine.title: Adaptive Journey Engine
journeyEngine.copy: A context-aware experience that changes as the traveller progresses.

cta.title: Try the demo
cta.description: See how one product can adapt from planning and departure through to arrival. ReadyGate is an independent concept, not affiliated with or endorsed by any airline.

footer.disclaimer: Passenger travel app concept by Jeff Schorr.
footer.affiliation: ReadyGate is not affiliated with or endorsed by any airline.
